title: What E-Residency Programs 2.0 Is
definition: E-Residency Programs 2.0: next-gen digital residency programs.
description:
E-Residency Programs 2.0 is next-gen digital residency programs. It sits squarely in Future Governance & Society, the frontier where digital IDs science becomes program logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are tax clarity-scale. Societies that master program hulls early will shape business access practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why digital IDs programs worldwide now treat E-Residency Programs 2.0 as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every E-Residency Programs 2.0 needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Real Research Today: E-Residency Programs 2.0
definition: Today's documented research behind E-Residency Programs 2.0.
description:
The road to E-Residency Programs 2.0 is already being paved. Liquid democracy pilots (LiquidFeedback, German Pirate Party) blend direct and representative voting. Citizens' assemblies (Ireland, France, Belgium) show sortition-based deliberation shaping national policy.

Prospera (Honduras ZEDE) and charter-city projects test zone-based governance. Together these programs form the digital IDs foundation that E-Residency Programs 2.0 will build on — the program logistics results, the business access methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as program logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: E-Residency Programs 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for E-Residency Programs 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for E-Residency Programs 2.0 — next-gen digital residency programs.

Phase 1 — Prove (digital IDs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (program logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (business access): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (tax clarity): program hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and nations-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
